changeSet.sql:
WITH seeded(post_id, topic_tag_id) AS ( VALUES (2000, 'arts-culture'), (2000, 'business'), (2001, 'health'), (2002, 'education'), (2002, 'cost-of-living'), (2003, 'transport'), (2003, 'cost-of-living'), (2004, 'climate-change'), (2004, 'technology'), (2005, 'arts-culture'), (2005, 'business'), (2006, 'artificial-intelligence'), (2006, 'education') ) INSERT INTO post_topic_tag_assignment (post_id, topic_tag_id, source, review_state, created_at) SELECT post_id, topic_tag_id, 'CREATOR', 'ACCEPTED', now() FROM seeded ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
WITH seeded(post_id, topic_tag_id) AS ( VALUES (2000, 'arts-culture'), (2000, 'business'), (2001, 'health'), (2002, 'education'), (2002, 'cost-of-living'), (2003, 'transport'), (2003, 'cost-of-living'), (2004, 'climate-change'), (2004, 'technology'), (2005, 'arts-culture'), (2005, 'business'), (2006, 'artificial-intelligence'), (2006, 'education') ) INSERT INTO effective_post_topic_tag (post_id, topic_tag_id, effective_source, updated_at) SELECT post_id, topic_tag_id, 'CREATOR', now() FROM seeded ON CONFLICT (post_id, topic_tag_id) DO NOTHING;

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM effective_post_topic_tag WHERE post_id BETWEEN 2000 AND 2006; DELETE FROM post_topic_tag_assignment WHERE post_id BETWEEN 2000 AND 2006;
